Home Applications Continuous 24/7 Brain Imaging of Stroke Patients Bedside Brain Imaging In Ambulance Brain Imaging for Triage of Stroke Patients Our Technology Overview Features Publications About us Our Company Our History Clinical and Scientific Advisory Board Recruitment Investment Patent Portfolio Contact us Request a Pitch Deck RF / SDR FPGA Engineer Location: Bangalore, India (On-site / Hybrid) Employment Type: Full-time or Contract About emtensor emtensor develops advanced microwave imaging systems for medical applications. We are building large-scale phase-coherent SDR arrays based on AD9363 transceivers and Xilinx Zynq platforms, where precise synchronization and deterministic timing across dozens of RF channels are critical to system performance. The Role We are looking for an experienced RF / SDR FPGA Engineer to take ownership of inter-board phase coherence and synchronization in a large multi-channel SDR system. This role focuses on FPGA development, clock distribution, deterministic timing, and AD936x transceiver synchronization. You will work on implementing and optimizing phase-coherent operation across a distributed SDR array using industry-standard synchronization techniques. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain AD9363/AD936x multi-chip synchronization (MCS). Develop FPGA logic for deterministic data capture and trigger-based synchronization. Design and optimize shared clock and reference distribution architectures. Work with Xilinx Zynq platforms and Vivado toolchains. Develop and debug RTL modules in Verilog, VHDL, or SystemVerilog. Implement coherent signal acquisition and processing mechanisms. Ensure phase repeatability and deterministic system behavior across multiple RF nodes. Perform timing closure, CDC analysis, and hardware debugging. Collaborate closely with RF, DSP, and software engineers. Required Qualifications 4+ years of FPGA development experience. Strong RTL design skills in Verilog, VHDL, or SystemVerilog. Hands-on experience with Xilinx Vivado and FPGA timing closure. Experience with Xilinx Zynq-7000, Zynq-7020, UltraScale+, or RFSoC platforms. Practical experience with AD9361, AD9363, or other AD936x-based SDR systems. Understanding of multi-channel synchronization, phase coherence, and deterministic timing. Experience with AXI4-Stream interfaces, clock-domain crossing (CDC), and FPGA debugging tools. Knowledge of DDS/NCO, FFT, and coherent sampling concepts. Preferred Qualifications Experience with phased arrays, beamforming, radar, or direction-finding systems. Familiarity with FMCOMMS platforms, libiio, no-OS environments, or USRP/UHD ecosystems. Experience with clock distribution systems, OCXO/VCTCXO references, LVDS synchronization, or clock-tree devices. Background in RF measurements and laboratory instrumentation. Experience in medical imaging, microwave imaging, or related technologies. Why Join emtensor? We are building a team of exceptional engineers to solve some of the most challenging problems in RF systems, signal processing, FPGA design, and medical imaging. At emtensor, you will work with a small, highly technical team where every engineer has a meaningful impact on the product and the company. We value technical excellence, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to solve difficult problems. If you are passionate about building world-class technology and want to work alongside other top engineers on problems that truly matter, we would love to hear from you. How to Apply Please send your CV to: lizaveta.shatalava@emtensor.com emtensor GmbH

Our systems rely on precise RF measurements and calibration across large multi-channel SDR arrays. We are looking for an engineer who can improve receiver performance through advanced calibration and dynamic-range extension techniques. The Role We are seeking a DSP / RF Calibration Engineer to take ownership of receiver calibration, dynamic-range optimization, and multi-gain measurement processing. You will develop algorithms and software that improve measurement quality by combining captures from multiple gain states, calibrating amplitude and phase responses, and ensuring accurate RF data across a wide dynamic range. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement multi-gain acquisition workflows for RF measurements. Design calibration procedures for amplitude and phase correction across receiver gain states. Develop algorithms for dynamic-range extension and gain-range stitching. Validate measurement quality, consistency, and calibration accuracy. Analyze receiver performance, noise floor, clipping behavior, and SNR. Build calibration and validation tools using Python, NumPy, MATLAB, and C. Prototype algorithms and integrate them into production software. Work closely with RF, FPGA, and software teams to improve overall system performance. Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience in DSP, signal processing, or RF measurement systems. Strong programming skills in Python and NumPy. Good C programming skills. Experience with calibration of measurement or receiver systems. Understanding of amplitude and phase correction techniques. Experience with dynamic-range extension, multi-gain processing, or range stitching. Knowledge of ADC behavior, clipping, noise floor analysis, and SNR optimization. Familiarity with AD9361, AD9363, AD936x, or comparable RF transceivers. Preferred Qualifications Experience with VNA calibration techniques (SOLT, TRL, or similar). Background in RF instrumentation and measurement systems. Experience with embedded software on ARM or Zynq platforms. Knowledge of S-parameters and RF network measurements. In this role, you will design, implement, optimise, and benchmark high-performance computing components used in advanced engineering and imaging systems. You will work on performance-critical software, develop GPU-accelerated solutions, and continuously improve system efficiency through profiling, optimisation, and algorithmic improvements. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can independently turn high-level concepts into robust and efficient implementations. What You Will Do Develop and optimise high-performance computing algorithms and software components. Design, implement, and optimise CUDA kernels for GPU-accelerated workloads. Profile, benchmark, and analyse software performance across different hardware platforms. Identify performance bottlenecks and implement data-driven improvements. Translate and maintain functionality across C++ and Python environments when required. Build efficient and scalable solutions for computationally intensive applications. Take ownership of assigned modules and deliver production-quality software with minimal supervision. Work directly on Linux-based systems and computing infrastructure. Collaborate closely with software, FPGA, RF, and algorithm teams to improve overall system performance. What We Are Looking For 2-4 years of professional software development experience. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python. Hands-on experience with CUDA kernel development and optimisation. Excellent understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity. Practical experience using profiling and debugging tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems, gdb, perf, nvtop, and related tooling. Solid understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, and performance optimisation techniques. Experience working independently in Linux environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a performance-oriented mindset. Ability to take high-level technical concepts and implement efficient, production-ready solutions. Nice to Have Experience with numerical computing libraries such as NumPy, CuPy, or SciPy. Knowledge of multithreading and concurrent programming techniques. Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows. Familiarity with scientific computing, signal processing, image processing, or high-performance computing applications. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. How to Apply Please send your CV and a short introduction to lizaveta.shatalava@emtensor.com emtensor GmbH

This role combines deep technical expertise with engineering leadership and will be responsible for building and scaling multidisciplinary engineering teams in Bangalore while collaborating closely with European team. The successful candidate will own the hardware and system architecture, drive product development from concept through production, and build a world-class engineering organization supporting emtensor’s future platform roadmap. Key Responsibilities Own the architecture and development of complex RF, analog, mixed-signal and embedded electronic systems. Lead end-to-end product development from concept, requirements definition and architecture through validation, certification and manufacturing. Build, scale and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams across hardware, systems, FPGA and embedded engineering. Recruit, develop and retain senior engineering talent. Drive technical decision-making, architecture reviews and design reviews. Collaborate with engineering teams across Europe and India. Lead system integration activities across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software and mechanical domains. Oversee schematic design, PCB architecture, board bring-up, debugging and validation activities. Define and execute hardware verification, validation and reliability strategies. Drive EMI/EMC design, compliance and certification activities. Manage technical risks, root cause investigations and corrective actions. Ensure products comply with regulatory and quality standards relevant to medical devices. Required Technical Expertise Strong expertise in hardware architecture and complex electronic system design. Deep knowledge of analog and mixed-signal electronics. Experience designing low-noise acquisition systems using ADCs, DACs and precision analog circuitry. Strong expertise in RF system design and RF front-end architectures. Experience with antenna systems, impedance matching networks and low-noise signal acquisition chains. Experience with high-speed digital interfaces including DDR, PCIe, USB, Ethernet and related SI/PI challenges. Working knowledge of FPGA-based systems, RTL workflows and high-speed digital architectures. Strong understanding of embedded system architectures and system-level integration. Expertise with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer and Cadence Allegro. Experience with signal integrity, power integrity and circuit simulation tools. Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, VNAs, spectrum analyzers and other advanced lab equipment. Strong debugging and root-cause analysis capabilities. Preferred Experience Medical devices, medical imaging, electromagnetic sensing, MRI/NMR, ultrasound, radar or other advanced sensing/acquisition systems. Experience with IEC 60601, ISO 14971, CE MDR, FDA or comparable regulated product environments. Experience supporting manufacturing transfer and product industrialization. Experience leading engineering organizations serving global markets. Leadership Requirements 15+ years of experience in hardware and systems engineering. 10+ years leading engineering teams. Experience building and managing teams of 10+ engineers. Proven experience scaling engineering organizations. Experience working with engineering organizations in Germany, Austria, the United States or other global R&D environments. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills. How to Apply Please send your CV and a short introduction to lizaveta.shatalava@emtensor.com emtensor GmbH

Home Applications Continuous 24/7 Brain Imaging of Stroke Patients Bedside Brain Imaging In Ambulance Brain Imaging for Triage of Stroke Patients Our Technology Overview Features Publications About us Our Company Our History Clinical and Scientific Advisory Board Recruitment Investment Patent Portfolio Contact us Request a Pitch Deck Python GUI & Robotic Arm (Fairino FR5) Integration Specialist Python GUI & Robotic Arm (Fairino FR5) Integration Specialist Background emtensor operates a Python-based GUI application that controls an imaging measurement system, used to run experiments and collect scans. To accelerate and automate the measurement process, we want to integrate a Fairino FR5 robotic arm (6DOF, 922mm reach, 5kg payload) to automate physical positioning during measurement. The robot should be controllable from within the existing measurement GUI, with both systems’ data combined into one unified output. In addition, we want the ability to control and run the entire measurement (including the robotic arm) remotely, so an operator can start and monitor a measurement run from anywhere, not just from the machine onsite. Project Goal Build a unified Python control hub that lets an operator run the measurement and the robotic arm from one GUI, with both systems’ data (measurement results and robot telemetry) logged together into a single, time-synchronized output file. The integration should automate sample/probe positioning to accelerate the measurement process, and the entire system (measurement + robot) should be controllable remotely, allowing an operator to run measurements from anywhere. Scope of Work 1. Robotic Arm Programming Use the official fairino-python-sdk to write modular control scripts for the FR5, covering jog control, point-to-point movement, speed/acceleration limits, and safety/error handling (including e-stop response and workspace limits appropriate for a collaborative robot). 2. GUI Integration Integrate the robot control scripts into the existing measurement GUI (currently built with Tkinter) without disrupting its existing scanning and experiment-running workflows. The robot controls should feel like a natural extension of the current interface, not a bolted-on separate tool. 3. Real-Time Monitoring Without Blocking Implement background threading (threading, asyncio, or equivalent) so that robot telemetry - joint positions, TCP coordinates, motion status, error states - updates live on the GUI without freezing or slowing down the measurement software. 4. Unified Data Logging Design a single data pipeline that timestamps and aligns robot telemetry with the measurement system’s scan data, writing both into one unified output file (CSV, JSON, or HDF5 - to be agreed with emtensor based on existing file conventions). 5. Remote Operation Implement a remote control capability so the integrated GUI (measurement + robotic arm) can be operated from a remote location - not just from the machine onsite. This includes secure remote access/connection to the GUI, remote start/stop/monitoring of measurement runs, and consideration of network latency and safety (e.g., ensuring the robot cannot be commanded into an unsafe state due to a dropped or delayed remote connection). 6. Testing and Safe Deployment Validate all robot motion logic in simulation (Fairino SimMachine or the WebApp simulator) before any testing on the physical arm. Onsite sessions will be used for hardware validation, safety checks, and final deployment. 7. Documentation and Handover Provide clear code documentation and a short handover guide, since emtensor’s internal team will maintain the code after the contract ends. Code should be delivered via Git with a clean commit history. Deliverables Integrated GUI with working robot control panel Unified data logging system (measurement + robot telemetry) Simulation test results prior to live deployment Source code in a Git repository with documentation Short handover session/guide for emtensor’s team How to Apply Please send your CV to lizaveta.shatalava@emtensor.com emtensor GmbH
